title: fix: preserve OpenAI image replay identity and edit framing
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fixes `/v1/images/generations` injecting a random default seed before cache lookup. Identical unseeded requests now use the existing seed 42 and reuse or rejoin one generation; callers wanting another image must vary their explicit seed. This behavioral change affects all image models.
- Preserves the existing `aspectRatio` field through both JSON and multipart edits instead of silently dropping it.
- Separates shared route changes from [FLUX.3 #16245](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/pull/16245), which should merge after this fix. No model definitions or provider routes change here.
- Validation: 51 focused Workers tests, Gen typecheck and Biome pass. Three real Seedream 5.0 Flash executions verified disconnect/rejoin, one upstream execution, stored media replay, portrait edits through both transports, one wallet debit/event per execution, and provider-reported costs against staging Tinybird. Provider calls were live; wallet, coordinator and media storage used local fixtures.

gist.headline: Same seed, same picture
gist.blurb: An unseeded image request stops rolling the dice before checking the cache. Image edits keep their requested framing, too.
gist.summary: The /v1/images/generations route uses seed 42 for unseeded requests before cache lookup, allowing identical requests across all image models to reuse or rejoin one generation; JSON and multipart edits also retain aspectRatio.
gist.impact: Repeated unseeded requests can replay the same image instead of starting separate generations; callers can set a different explicit seed for a different image, and edits keep their requested aspect ratio.
gist.visual_concept: Polli sorts identical seed packets marked 42 into one glowing image frame, while a second portrait-shaped frame represents edits retaining their aspect ratio. A small code-plant garden ties the cache and framing fixes together; no new model or provider mascot is needed.
